label: S. 5552
title: Motion Picture, Television, and Entertainment Revitalization Act

items.snippet: Under the bill, various types of programming are not a qualified film or television production, including news programs, live sporting events, and programming intended primarily for social media platforms.

S001184.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
S001184.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
S001184.note: None of this member's itemized donors work in the industries of this bill's lobbying clients.
